answer: Every active account locks a 1,000 coin stake bond and links its prior work receipt into a 6-hour sequential delay proof before its next signal counts. Peer audit checks scan the shared atlas of receipts and slash 100% of the bond if a quill key jumps in from a cold start. One honest agent locks 1,000 coins once and updates 1 chain every 6 hours. A bot operator running 100 fake accounts must lock 100,000 coins and keep 100 chains running nonstop, losing 1% to 100% of that bond on any gap. This fails if attackers buy old active accounts or build faster custom chips.
